name: Surrealism
visualIdentity: Supplemental reference, not a canonical source-collection label. Set impossible scale, object relationships or gravity inside convincing space and consistent lighting. Keep one coherent dream logic; use photorealistic or painterly rendering. An unusual scene alone is not Surrealism.
suitableUses: Explicitly suggested for single dreamlike images. Inferred fit: brand films, music videos, narrative openers, art campaigns and poster-like frames. For interactive HTML, prerendered scroll-scrubbed sequences or centered stills with optional slow zoom can carry the dream logic.
limitations: Avoid rushed transformations, hidden cuts, camera intersections, clutter and mixed rendering styles. Dense text during travel, one-shot constraints, stable-orientation needs or reduced-motion requirements may call for adapting or omitting motion. Palette is reference-dependent; no intrinsic colors are specified.
palette: Optional four-token example for new art only: background #EDE5D7, foreground #302D35, accent_1 #617C8B, accent_2 #B26E51. Supplied, brand, approved and existing semantic colors take precedence; preserve values, roles and asset colors. No gradient. Accent pairings are decorative, not body text; verify actual composited contrast. Lighting and reflections must remain coherent.
motionAndInteraction: Let impossible transformations unfold calmly while preserving composition and narrative continuity. Blender keyframes or cached simulation can drive camera and deformation; cache or deterministically replay state. For video, derive all states from seekable composition time, not live input. Optional hybrids: a meaningful camera passage through impossible space, or calm frontal symmetry with a slow push-in. Interactive HTML may map a finite scroll range to the same states; provide still or reduced-motion alternatives where appropriate.
audio: No fixed soundtrack or mandatory layer. Choose music, voiceover, sung vocals, effects, ambience or silence for the subject and audience; state assumptions when inputs are absent. Honor supplied audio choices and assets, synchronize and mix with picture, and check intelligibility, balance, clipping and sync.
assetRequirements: Resolve scene and subject colors from selected references. Build or source geometry, materials, lighting and animation with Blender and its bundled Python API; Cycles supports path tracing, while EEVEE offers faster real-time-style rendering. Prepare assets and cache stateful simulation. Native Canvas or SVG may suffice; a 3D engine is not required for those layers. Distinguish simulated appearance from physical production or validated physics.
combinations: Surrealism alone suits a single dreamlike image. A continuous impossible-space camera journey supports brand films, music videos and openers if dream logic and lighting stay consistent. Frontal symmetry stages an impossible central object for campaigns and key frames. Optional narrative patterns should serve real story progression; avoid conflicting progress drivers or obscuring essential copy. Motion catalogs are candidates only when their scene geometry and action fit.
productionApproach: Choose renderer and motion engine by style, action, assets and fidelity; Blender/bpy own visual construction and motion, Cycles or EEVEE rendering as needed. HyperFrames is the default composition, seekable timing, media/audio sync, validation and export pipeline; Remotion is allowed only if unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a required capability, with reason recorded. Keep specialist rendering and motion separate from pipeline. Inspect representative and decoded frames, watch the full video, and verify dimensions, duration, frame rate, audio sync and loop continuity. For HTML interaction, separate live pointer/scroll behavior from video timing.
